idea: Replace single DecisionTreeClassifier with RandomForestClassifier to reduce variance and improve generalization via bagging.
Replace RandomForestClassifier with ExtraTreesClassifier to introduce additional randomization at split points, further reducing ensemble variance.
Increase n_estimators to 300 in RandomForestClassifier to reduce variance and achieve more stable probability estimates.
Switch to HistGradientBoostingClassifier as gradient boosted trees often outperform random forests on tabular classification benchmarks.
Increase max_iter to 300 in HistGradientBoostingClassifier to allow further boosting iterations and better convergence.
Decrease min_samples_leaf to 10 in HistGradientBoostingClassifier to allow finer leaf splits on fine-grained class boundaries.
Increase max_leaf_nodes to 63 in HistGradientBoostingClassifier to allow deeper trees and richer feature interactions.
Increase max_iter to 500 in HistGradientBoostingClassifier to allow further boosting iterations and improve convergence.
